The breakthrough arrived in the 32nd minute when Angel Correa turned provider, setting up Sebastian Driussi for a clinical finish. Banfield struggled to find an answer to the visitors' fluid attacking play as the momentum stayed firmly with the team in white and red. Just before the halftime break, the visitors doubled their advantage. In the 41st minute, a penalty was awarded to River Plate , and Thiago Almada stepped up to the spot. With great composure, Almada fired the ball home to make it 2-0. The referee blew for halftime shortly after, leaving the hosts with a significant mountain to climb in the second period. A Spirited Fightback and Late Drama The second half saw Banfield introduce Bruno Sepulveda , a move that paid dividends in the 64th minute when he found the back of the net to reduce the deficit. However, River Plate responded almost instantly. In the 69th minute, Tomas Galvan played a pinpoint pass to Angel Correa , who scored to restore the two-goal cushion and seemingly put the game out of reach. Banfield refused to surrender, and the final ten minutes were filled with tension. In the 84th minute, Lisandro Pinero delivered a perfect assist for Bruno Sepulveda , who grabbed his second goal of the match to set up a grandstand finish. Despite a flurry of late substitutions, including Mauro Arambarri and Lautaro Rivero coming on for their respective sides, River Plate managed to weather the storm and secure a hard-fought victory as the referee blew the final whistle at 90+5'.
